title: Hanging weight pulls a block (ঝুলন্ত ভর ও টেবিলের বস্তু)
placement: Book pages 81–83, topic 3.7: next to চিত্র ৩.০৯ (a hanging mass pulls a body on the table over a pulley), the page's T = ma, T − Mg = M(−a), a = Mg/(M+m), and চিত্র ৩.১০ with its a = 5g/(m+15).
description: Newton's second law with a rope over a pulley (pages 81–83, topic 3.7), at a village well: the well is cut in half so its shaft, the water and a yellow bucket can be seen; a man in a blue shirt pulls the rope over the pulley on a wooden frame hand over hand, in a courtyard with a terracotta mud house, a tin roof, a haystack and a deep blue sky. One light rope over a smooth pulley carries one tension T (the book's 'একটি সুতায় একটি মাত্র টান বল'), so his pull is the rope's pull on the bucket. The student chooses the pull T and the bucket with its water M with two steppers (or the row of words ধরে রাখো, জোরে টানো, কম টানো, বেশি পানি), and the panel works out the book's law for the bucket live, up being positive: T − Mg = Ma, each symbol a button that makes its arrow pulse, the sum with the student's numbers and a = (T − Mg)/M. One tap runs it (time slowed 3 times): the bucket speeds up going up, or going down (a negative, the book's M(−a)), or stays where it is held (T = Mg); arrows show T at the bucket and at his fists (the same number), the weight Mg and a, and a chip shows the bucket's velocity growing by a each second; the notes (the cut, the light rope, the sign rule) sit in the panel, not on the picture. The book's own pictures open in a উদাহরণ window: চিত্র ৩.০৯ (a hanging mass M pulls a body m on a smooth table: T = ma, N − mg = 0, T − Mg = M(−a), a = Mg/(M+m), T less than Mg) and চিত্র ৩.১০ (10 kg and 5 kg at the two ends: a = 5g/(m+15)), each on its own small 3D bench that runs, solved line by line with steppers for the masses the book leaves as letters. Test tab: 5 questions on the well (a from T and M; T when held still; which way when T < Mg; one rope, one tension; the same pull with more water), every wrong choice a real mistake with its own note. Phone-first, Bangla and English.
